title: Separate whole paid fields across the 36 P104 binary calls
body:
## Result

Under the pinned caller’s disjoint physical stage embedding, one arbitrary complete old MOVE payload from each of 36 distinct native invocations can be prescribed independently. This holds in both orientations and for arbitrary choices of MOVE. Set the two hub roots to zero. On the first oriented main half, the 36 arm-to-pre-LOCAL matrix is diagonal and invertible modulo q+1. The square-zero inverse lifts to full fields. Fresh private inputs then set each other selected receipt.

Keeping both original receipt observations and their neutral identity-packet baseline, a single N-site paid lane cannot implement the two independent old interchange defects. The complete price permits the hypothetical merges (5,6) and (6,6) at 0.00388, with formal margins +0.00146288207 and +0.00429493000, respectively. Both fail the rank bound. The 81-site and doubled-volume 162-site controls confirm its capacity distinction.

At stage 18, nine actual native one-scalar terminal decoder identities become exact if the matching external hub field is supplied. Port 9/chart 534 needs it by native clock 20953. Earlier unshifted caller stock misses the hub, and an independent-slot argument excludes all four QUERYs and 32 paid idles as single substitutions preserving their original clocked outputs. A positive alternate QUERY operand at clock 198 preserves its old value and still supplies no fresh final hub. One return cannot fund two of the named recipients under the tested stock.

## Replay

Archive SHA-256 `93e77279e05549b919ff422e5fcdf642eec81339d9c91da471b41d0e5f0db27d`. Both independently extracted inner archives passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -IB verify.py`. Pinned #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, and [disjoint stage scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1/research/paired-query-only-bit/PROOF.md#L78-L87).

## Prior work and open next questions

The neutral full-field proof goes beyond the prior two-port and one-role scalar screens. #8022 fixes a local native chart and studies helper endpoint exchanges. A changed blocked baseline, independently funded hub delivery, or multiple paid lanes needs a distinct replay and fully signed application. No new κ bound.

Canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The comparable complete bound comes from #7863 `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781` and replay #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca`. Clear1nsight prepared this proof with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds and the native, caller, and verifier contributors retained in the archive.
